extension_2026-08-26_a_wider_sweep_finds.why: Paper IV's theorem was scoped to SEVEN invariants. Seven is a small sample and the claim invited the misreading that H_1 = Z is the UNIQUE object-level handle.

not_claimed: that any of OA-C0016 / OA-C0018 / OA-C1063 / OA-C1064 is resolved -- none is PROVED and this paper does not change that

family.corollary_input: any construction whose input is the invariant trace field takes a FAMILY-LEVEL input: all 14 members supply the same field and would proceed identically
family.corollary_volume: vol(m004) = (3 sqrt3/2) L(chi_-3, 2) is shared with m003, hence a FAMILY property -- it cannot participate in any argument needing to distinguish m004 within the family
family.escape: select on H_1 = Z FIRST -- that step is genuinely object-level -- and a later trace-field step inherits the selection. What is forbidden is the reverse order.
family.theorem: of seven elementary invariants, exactly ONE separates m004 within the 14 orientable cusped census manifolds of shape field Q(sqrt-3): H_1 = Z

orbit.escape: exactly TWO, and they are exhaustive: (i) shrink the group so orbits break up (e.g. Q-linear -> Z-linear, where failure of homogeneity creates new invariants); (ii) add non-invariant structure. Exhaustive because any successful selector either fails G-invariance or is invariant for a smaller group.
orbit.theorem: a G-invariant I is constant on each G-orbit, so no function of I alone distinguishes two points of one orbit; no REFINEMENT of the same invariant ever will
orbit.why_a_theorem_not_a_gap: a failure to select a point of an orbit is not weak evidence -- it is a proof the evidence is of the WRONG TYPE, so sharpening I is provably wasted effort

scale.escape: DIMENSIONLESS quantities -- ratios, phases, mixing angles, integer counts -- are untouched. Stated explicitly because the theorem is easy to overstate into 'nothing numerical can be obtained', which is FALSE and would close the one lane the argument leaves open.
scale.theorem: Mostow fixes shape not size; vol(cover) = d * vol(base) with no distinguished degree, so no dimensionful quantity is determined by the isometry type

two_errors_reported_in_the_paper.float_equality_on_CS: comparing Chern-Simons by exact equality made m004's 9e-17 look unique, producing a SPURIOUS second separating property. Five other members have CS = 0. The error inverted the conclusion in the direction that FLATTERED it.
two_errors_reported_in_the_paper.neighbouring_property: testing torsion-freeness instead of the knot-complement condition. m202 and m203 are torsion-free with H_1 = Z + Z. Substituting an easier-to-compute property for the one at issue is undetectable WITHIN the computation, because the computation is correct -- it answers a different question.

controls: CS compared with an EXPLICIT stated tolerance 1e-9, never equality; the run PRINTS both answers (4 others by equality vs 5 by tolerance) so the difference is visible
torsion-freeness and H_1 = Z both computed and reported separately, so substituting one for the other is visible rather than silent
